messages:
Lina: hi all, lina here on day 2. trying to run the example pipeline from the onboarding repo and the step that pushes to GHCR fails with `denied`. not sure if i should be using a PAT or if the org GitHub App is already installed for new hires. who handles repo/app access?

Buildkite Bot: build #11 failed: step `publish-image` (exit 1)
```
> Pushing to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/onboarding-lina:branch-1
> denied: requested access to the resource is denied
> failed to push some refs to 'ghcr.io/redwood-inference/onboarding-lina'
```

Lina: pipeline env uses GHCR_PAT from my onboarding checklist. i picked default scopes during token creation (repo + workflow).

Marco: welcome! :wave: short version: GHCR needs package write permission. the onboarding flow can be either the org GitHub App (preferred) or a PAT with `write:packages` + `read:packages`. sounds like your PAT is missing `packages`.

Asha: adding detail: when we onboard, infra sometimes auto-installs the GH App for the `onboarding` repo group, but not always for personal sandboxes. @Marco can you check if the GitHub App is installed on `redwood-inference/onboarding`?

Marco: checked — org app is installed for the main repos but not the personal sandboxes. ops policy was to avoid granting package access to all personal forks. for your pipeline either regen a PAT with packages scope or i can temporarily add your user to `ci-testers` on GitHub so the GH App covers you.

Lina: is there a quick local test to validate the token before i rerun Buildkite?

Asha: yes run locally:
```
echo "$MY_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u <your-gh-username> --password-stdin
docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/onboarding-lina:test-canary
```
if that returns `denied` then your PAT lacks `write:packages`. also `gh auth status` helps show the account.

Lina: ran the docker login test and got denied as well. i'll regen with packages and update the Buildkite pipeline env.

Lina: updated GHCR_PAT in the Buildkite pipeline settings and requeued the build.

Buildkite Bot: build #12 started  - step `publish-image`

Buildkite Bot: build #12 succeeded :tada: - pushed ghcr.io/redwood-inference/onboarding-lina:branch-1

Lina: awesome, thanks! leaving a note in the onboarding doc about this nuance. @Marco can we coordinate a short walkthrough of the org app flow later?

Marco: yup, happy to do a 15min walkthrough. ping me when you're free. :calendar:
